name: Color Bends
description: Full-size WebGL shader background of flowing, warped bands of color that drift over time and bend gently toward the pointer. Supports transparency, rotation, grain and up to 8 custom colors.
contents: Single container div filled by a Three.js WebGL canvas running a fragment shader
behavior: Continuous animated flowing color bands driven by time and speed
Pointer movement over the container shifts and bends the pattern with smoothed easing
Optional constant auto rotation on top of a fixed base rotation
Canvas resizes with the container through ResizeObserver
Without colors, the shader renders a default 3-channel RGB band pattern
editableByProps: Band colors (hex, up to 8), speed, scale, frequency, warp, band width and intensity
Rotation angle and auto rotation speed
Pointer reaction through mouseInfluence and parallax
Grain amount, transparency and container classes or style

needsCodeEdit.change: Raise the maximum number of colors above 8

needsCodeEdit.where: renderer.setPixelRatio call in the first useEffect

fixed: Requires the three package and WebGL support in the browser
Fills its parent: root is w-full h-full, so the parent needs a defined height
Pointer events are listened to on the container only, so it needs pointer events enabled to react to the mouse
Pixel ratio capped at 2 and antialiasing is off
Continuous requestAnimationFrame render loop that never pauses offscreen
Changing speed, scale, frequency, warpStrength, mouseInfluence, parallax, noise, iterations, intensity, bandWidth or transparent recreates the renderer
Iterations effect is capped at 5 passes by the shader loop
Colors must be hex strings, 3 or 6 digits
className defaults to undefined, so the class string may contain the word undefined when omitted
